# Bättre än väntat av Rusta – Hoists vd om nya målen

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This EFN Morgon episode opens with macro risks: oil near $99/bbl after new attacks on Iranian oil infrastructure, US long-bond auctions and Bessent's buyback plan, and Handelsbanken's forecast that the Riksbank will hike twice (December 2026 and summer 2027) on a broad recovery. On company news, Rusta's Q1 beat expectations and the stock rose on the open, while Hoist's CEO explained its raised 2030 targets (ROE floor 20%, 15% annual EPS growth) and the guest called the valuation undemanding. Other items were Inditex's in-line report as a read-across to H&M, an SEB upgrade of Kinnevik, a JP Morgan negative watch on Elekta, two new IPOs and Evolution's compliance issues. The overall mood was mixed: the Stockholm market opened red while individual company news was mostly positive.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HOFI — Hoist Finance | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Raised 2030 targets (ROE >20%, EPS growth 15%/yr); guest sees P/E 10-11x 2028 as not expensive vs banks at 12-13x.

#### Reasoning

Guest Anders Rudolfsson (Ålandsbanken) notes strong EPS growth with a forward P/E of ~10-11x vs Swedish banks at 12-13x, despite much higher ROE. The CEO expects scale benefits in collection costs and a structural supply of NPLs as European banks sell earlier. Caveats: risk differential, black-box portfolio valuation, and targets largely already achieved.

#### Sell Triggers

- if EPS growth falls below 15% target
- if portfolio valuation/credit risk issues surface
- if European NPL supply dries up

> *"Tittar man in i nåt år framåt, eller inåt 2028 så har vi P på 10–11 gånger. Det är inte speciellt dyrt"*

---

### 🟡 RUSTA — Rusta | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Good report, margin upside in Finland/Germany, but weak LFL; analyst says better to shop in stores than buy the stock.

#### Reasoning

EFN analyst Ture Wester calls it a good report with margin gains in other markets and store expansion potential, but wants better like-for-like (2.2%) and margins; peers Clas Ohlson/Puuilo have higher margins at similar valuation. His summary: 'better deal to shop in the stores than in the shares'.

#### Sell Triggers

- if like-for-like stays weak
- if transport cost headwinds hit Q2 margins
- if margin expansion outside Sweden stalls

> *"just nu så är det väl kanske en bättre affär att handla i butikerna än i aktier"*

---

### 🟢 KINV-B — Kinnevik | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

SEB upgraded Kinnevik to buy from hold (cited analyst opinion); stock up 4-7%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion only: SEB raised its recommendation to buy from hold. The hosts did not give their own view beyond reporting the market reaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if SEB reverses the upgrade
- if portfolio company valuations are written down

> *"Vi har ju fått en rekhöjning i Kinnevik. De höjs från köp från behåll från SEB."*

---

### 🟠 EKTA-B — Elekta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

JP Morgan negative watch (cited analyst); stock down 1.6%.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion: JP Morgan put Elekta on negative watch, which weighed on the shares. The hosts added no further view.

> *"där har man också fått En negativ watch från JP Morgan"*

---
